info.title: CSV Analyser API
info.description: High-performance FastAPI backend for CSV data analysis, Open Icecat product enrichment, preview, and visualizations with MongoDB persistence.

post.description:
Upload a CSV file, enrich all products with Open Icecat technical specs & media,
save the newly generated enriched CSV, and return enrichment statistics and preview.

Upload a CSV, audit each product row against live Google/DuckDuckGo web index data,
calculate data closeness/fidelity scores, detect discrepancies, and return comprehensive insights.

get.description: Download the verified CSV file containing web closeness scores, verification status, and audit insights.
Download the generated enriched CSV file with all Open Icecat and technical parameters.

post.description: Directly streams back the enriched CSV file as an attachment without requiring a secondary download.
Audit and cross-verify a single Brand + Model against live Google/DuckDuckGo web index data.
Query Open Icecat directly for a single Brand + Model Code combination.

Upload a CSV file, parse it, and return metadata with preliminary statistical summary.
Also saves analysis record into MongoDB if connected.

get.description: List uploaded dataset records stored in MongoDB.

schema.title: Response List Datasets Api Csv Datasets Get

get.description: Get detailed dataset metadata (row/col count, memory usage, duplicate count, null count).
Get full statistical summary, column-level distributions, and correlation matrix.
Get paginated rows of the dataset.

post.description: Filter, sort, and paginate rows based on column conditions.
Generate aggregated data points for visual charts (bar, line, pie, histogram).

delete.description: Delete dataset record from MongoDB and local storage.

get.description: Detailed MongoDB connection status and ping check.
